US commercial real estate outlook 2026

US commercial real estate transaction volume reached $398 billion in 2025. Investment is expected to rise 8% in 2026 as borrowing conditions improve.

Logistics and multifamily remain the most liquid sectors; office volumes are recovering from a low base.

This fictional outlook was prepared for a software demonstration.
